title: Evaluation of the mechanical and chemical properties of bitumen fractionation via time efficient chromatography techniques
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9594-9604
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA09045D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Brittany Hallmark-Haack, Joshua Middleton, Ana Luiza Rodrigues, Michael Forrester, R. Christopher Williams, Eric Cochran
The study presents a fast, scalable flash chromatography method for bitumen fractionation, surpassing traditional SARA. It enables multigram separations in one step, allowing full characterization and deeper asphalt insights for enhanced performance.
